Ben, have you tried removing the executable, *.o, *.d, and *.cpp by hand? Does that fix the current state of your unit test?

We have pull request 140 still open. Can you pull that into your repository and see if the make target there fixes the issue? I don't think I saw any comments regarding that pull request.
